title: lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius subsp. scassellatii
intro: Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius subsp. scassellatii, commonly known as "tree of life" or "kakamega oak", is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. It is traditionally used in East African medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive compounds, which provide numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius subsp. scassellatii include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
